# partiteai Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "partiteai" {
  endpoint  = "https://api.partite.ai/graphql"
  api_token = var.partite_api_token
}

variable "partite_api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Deprecated) The API key ID used to authenticate with the Partite AI API.
- `api_secret` (String, Sensitive, Deprecated) The API secret used to authenticate with the Partite AI API.
- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) The API token used to authenticate with the Partite AI API. It starts with `prt_ak_`. Can also be set with the `PARTITE_AI_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) The base URL for the Partite AI API. For example, `https://api.partite.ai/graphql`
- `enterprise` (Boolean) Whether the endpoint is an enterprise deployment. Some resources, such as `partiteai_rubric` and `partiteai_eval_mesh_monitor`, exist only there and the provider refuses to use them anywhere else. Defaults to true when the endpoint's host ends with `.partite.ai`, and false otherwise, so a self-hosted mesh does not have to set it.
